title: Claude Modes and Permissions
content:
Claude Modes and Permissions: 

Claude Modes are settings that change how much Claude asks for user approval. There are three modes: Manual, Accept edits, and Auto.

Manual mode asks for approval before every single change.

Accept edits mode writes and edits files automatically without asking, but still asks before running other commands.

Auto mode allows Claude to decide when to ask for approval, especially for risky commands.

Modes are used to set limits before things get crazy. Permissions control what Claude can touch on your machine. An allow list includes things Claude can always do without asking, and a deny list includes things it can never do. You can use /permissions to see and change those rules.
